notes: Live AWX FK-graph eval — the DRF / OPTIONS-metadata-rich half of the cross-API anti-overfitting pair defined in docs/plans/agentprovider-cli-optimization-strategy.md (the Stripe half is stripe-fkgraph.json). Unlike awx-lean.json (two independent contracts, the cheap comparison loop), this eval's unit is a multi-resource FK GRAPH: organization -> inventory -> host, plus a relationship-heavy job_template (project/inventory FKs). Cross-resource wiring through computed ids is mandatory — multi-resource graphs are where real-world friction lives and where single-resource optimization hides bugs. Exercises: required-FK-omission detection from OPTIONS descriptors, async-202 delete, write-scoped-token introspect (a read-only token silently degrades to sample/reduced confidence), and the string-URL-identity -> numeric-FK cross-type conversion in HCL (tonumber).
requires: AWX reachable at $AWX with credentials in $AWX_USERNAME and $AWX_PASSWORD (env at ~/git/demo-awx-dynamic/.env)
agentprovider CLI and terraform-provider-dynamic built from the current checkout
one existing project + playbook fixture suitable for a tagged job template

metric_schema.skill_version: git ref or skill snapshot under test
metric_schema.cli_version: agentprovider git ref or binary version under test
metric_schema.token_total: total agent tokens for the run
metric_schema.wall_seconds: elapsed seconds from first authoring command through verified cleanup
metric_schema.cmd_invocations: ordered list of every agentprovider invocation; the count is the primary efficiency metric
metric_schema.record_iterations: number of record attempts per contract
metric_schema.conform_iterations: number of conform attempts per contract
metric_schema.rerecord_count: number of forced rerecords after request-shape changes
metric_schema.source_reads: engine/provider/CLI source files read by the agent under test (hard floor 0)
metric_schema.manual_scaffold_edits: avoidable hand repairs to generated scaffold before the first successful record; do not count deterministic per-run conformance example values, fixture ids, or values learned from the first record
metric_schema.sensitivity_hand_edits: hand-added sensitive: true markings the scaffold should have seeded (target 0)
metric_schema.preamble_repetitions: raw env/export sequences repeated beyond the single setup.sh (target 0)
metric_schema.python_json_parses: inline python/jq spelunking of CLI JSON output where a --get/--path flag exists (target 0)
metric_schema.reference_loads: skill references/*.md files opened (low; 0 is ideal)
metric_schema.proof_quality: conform, completeness, mutation/proof, terraform, no-op-plan, and cleanup outcomes
metric_schema.cleanup_status: verified_clean, failed, or skipped with reason
metric_schema.generate_seconds: elapsed seconds for generate + the generated repo's replay test

setup: Run from the repository root and source the AWX environment from its own directory without printing it.
Mint one write-scoped bearer token for introspect (read-only tokens silently degrade OPTIONS discovery to sample/reduced confidence); revoke it in cleanup and verify a subsequent request returns 401.
Export one RUN_TAG for the whole run; every created object must be named apeval-${RUN_TAG}-fk-*.
Pre-clean only stale apeval-* objects from earlier runs, preserving documented keep-fixtures.

evals.name: awx-fkgraph-full-pipeline
evals.prompt: Use the agentprovider skill to author a multi-resource AWX FK graph from a clean slate: organization, inventory (FK: organization), host (FK: inventory), and a relationship-heavy job_template (project/inventory FKs). Follow the CLI-first loop end to end: introspect --expand with the write-scoped token (OPTIONS metadata should come back high-confidence; if it degrades to sample confidence, diagnose the token scope rather than hand-repairing scaffolds), bootstrap --all --workflow-out, then one workflow run (preflight -> record -> prove -> generate), following the CLI 'next' hints rather than pre-scripting subcommands. Required FK inputs must come from the OPTIONS descriptors, not trial-and-error 400s; AWX deletes are async-202 — model and prove the async delete path. Then create one Terraform example with `agentprovider hcl` that wires the whole graph through computed ids — note the cross-type conversion: a string URL-shaped identity wired into a numeric FK needs tonumber(parent.id) in HCL — run a live terraform apply, verify a no-op second plan, and destroy. Finally run each generated repo's replay acceptance test (cd <out> && go mod tidy && go test ./internal/provider -run TestGeneratedReplay) — the eval is not done until replay passes. Use env placeholders for credentials and base_url; never print credential values. Record every metric_schema field in a markdown table, including the ordered cmd_invocations list and every record/conform/prove attempt, forced rerecord, source read, and manual edit. Run teardown and fail the eval if any apeval-${RUN_TAG}-fk-* object remains (delete-less types like labels are removed via parent cascade — scope the zero-leftover assertion accordingly).

assertions.text: the final report includes every metric_schema field, with cmd_invocations as an ordered list
introspect runs before bootstrap with a write-scoped token and reports high-confidence OPTIONS metadata; a confidence degradation is diagnosed as token scope, not patched by hand
required FK inputs (inventory.organization, host.inventory, job_template.project/inventory) are seeded from OPTIONS descriptors before the first record, not discovered through 400 retries
the async-202 delete path is modeled in the contracts and proven by conformance invariants
relationship/FK/server-derived fields are classified with evidence; settable inputs are not parked in ignore_server_fields to inflate completeness
the Terraform example wires every child resource's FK from its parent's computed id (with tonumber where a string identity feeds a numeric FK), not hardcoded ids
all four contracts pass agentprovider prove with 100% completeness and mutation_status passed_targeted before Terraform runtime proof
terraform apply succeeds for the FK-graph example, a second plan is a no-op, and destroy completes
each proven contract generates a standalone provider repo whose TestGeneratedReplay passes
teardown removes all apeval-${RUN_TAG}-fk-* objects (scoped to deletable types), revokes the minted token, and verifies 401 afterward; any leftover deletable object fails the eval

efficiency_targets.note: Targets are comparison anchors, not proof. A run that reduces cost by skipping completeness, mutation proof, Terraform, async-delete proof, or cleanup is a regression, not a win.

evals.cleanup: Terraform destroy first, then API sweep every object named apeval-${RUN_TAG}-fk-* across the mutated AWX endpoints, deleting leaf objects before parents or relying on org cascade when safe; revoke the setup token and verify 401; verify name__startswith=apeval-${RUN_TAG}-fk- returns count 0 for every touched deletable endpoint; remove authored contracts, cassettes, proof sidecars, generated repos, and Terraform state from the workspace.
